MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wired earbuds with a microphone connect to my earlier headset interest because they serve a similar listening and calling purpose, though I would only consider buying if I needed a replacement."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "A tablet mount helps me use a tablet I already have; it does not indicate that I want another tablet.",
    "Streaming devices and smart speakers do not solve the connection or accessory needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "Memory cards and a card reader do not address a storage need I have expressed. A USB connection alone does not make the reader useful to me.",
    "My DVI cable purchase reflected a particular connection requirement; an HDMI cable is only useful if my equipment needs that connector."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in more electronic devices, rather than accessories for specific tasks.",
    "Owning tablet or USB accessories seems to have been taken as interest in related devices and storage products, even when their purpose differs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases are infrequent and appear tied to particular practical needs; an older purchase does not establish a current replacement need.",
    "The exact function and connector matter to me: Ethernet access, additional USB ports, a DVI connection, and a tablet mount solve different problems.",
    "Even a relevant audio accessory would not prompt me to buy without a current reason to replace what I have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but missed the specific practical needs that make an accessory worth buying."
}
